decisionsTheCaptainShouldKnow: The proposed-order component (NM-SAN-JUAN-NONCONVICTION-PACKET) is bound by hash and NOT rendered. The manifest conditions it on filing in San Juan County; neither fixture does; the binary is the Eleventh Judicial District's whole 31-page packet, county-captioned as page content, dated 2022-01-28, citing the 2019 statute; the shared host renders whole binaries and this lane may not change it. Rendering it would promote a county-local, pre-amendment packet statewide. Recorded in source-receipt.json, the manifest reconciliation, build-findings.json and the instructions.

The held case number is NOT written. Form 4-952 paragraph 4 asks for it by the court it was in (District, or Metropolitan/Magistrate/Municipal) and the intake collects the originating court because cases on this track commonly originated in a lower court; the host's dictionary is static, so a write on the District Court line would assert on a sworn petition that the case was a district court case. Both lines are required-before-filing with the reason on the row; the boundary fixture is a magistrate-court case. This diverges from nm_conviction-set deliberately and is raised for the reviewer.

Two parties are served on this track (district attorney and DPS), not three; Form 4-960.1's twenty page-2 blanks are required-before-filing on that ground, through the shared serviceBlocksOf parameter.

rows.stopReason: The codified text of La. C.Cr.P. art. 994 -- the Motion for Interim Expungement, which the committed packet-set manifest marks as this family's REQUIRED primary filing and which the owner determination LA-STATUTORY-FORMS says to 'generate faithfully from the current codified article text' -- is held nowhere in this container, and neither is art. 988 for the conditional fee exemption. Nothing has changed since lane PF27 stopped this family on the same ground at base 1cc823b6: the acquisition target la-ccrp-art-994-statutory-form-print-view still carries expectedSha256 null and status BLOCKED_NOT_ACQUIRED, no commit since PF27's base touches the Louisiana legal-design records, the source-acquisition records or the owner determinations, and the two owner questions PF27 raised about art. 995 remain unanswered.
howTheAbsenceWasEstablished: Every Louisiana entry in the committed corpus index resolves to six documents -- arts. 984, 990, 993, 995, 998 and 999.1 -- in three custodies; none is art. 994 or art. 988.

Every file under STATES/LA in the mounted Master Library and every file in human-source-returns was searched, the PDFs through pdftotext, for 'Art. 994', 'Art. 988' and the caption 'MOTION FOR INTERIM EXPUNGEMENT'. Zero hits in any PDF; the only file mentioning interim expungement is the Louisiana legal review, which DESCRIBES the form and does not print its wording.

git grep over HEAD for the form's caption returns only records ABOUT the obligation (acquisition manifests, census records, PF27's own return) and no codified text; the compiled LA profile carries the pathway's label and summary and no article text; src/lib/rcap/state-packs/la does not exist.

data/rcap-grade-a/source-acquisition/wave-1/acquired.json ordinal 17 (this family's art. 994) is BLOCKED_NOT_ACQUIRED with sha256 null; SOURCE_ACQUISITION_MANIFEST.json still lists la-ccrp-art-994-statutory-form-print-view with expectedSha256 null.

rows.whyNotComposedFromTheDescription: La. C.Cr.P. art. 986(A) makes the statutory forms exclusive and the committed LA.memo.json note says the rendering must reproduce the Legislature's own words rather than paraphrase them, with the court name the only authorised variation under art. 986(C). The assignment forbids inventing statutory content and requires every sentence to be grounded in the legal-design records; those records describe art. 994 and do not carry its text. A motion composed from a description would put words in the Legislature's mouth on a form the Code makes exclusive.
rows.whyNotFetchedFromLegisLaGov: Source acquisition is its own lane kind in the claim ledger with its own manifest, custody and receipt machinery. This lane holds a packet-build grant only; fetching and pinning a new source would be minting work outside the grant.
rows.whyNotShippedWithoutThePrimaryFiling: The route's own filing rule (LA.memo.json rules.filing) is to file the Article 994 motion with the proposed Article 995 order. A packet without the motion is not a filing. The held art. 995 text was not composed either: PF27's two unanswered owner questions -- whether this family's composedFromAuthority grant (exactly ART-988 and ART-994) reaches art. 995, and whether the memo's standing 'no implementation is authorized here' on the art. 995 template still holds -- are not this lane's to settle.
whatWouldReleaseThisFamily: A source-acquisition lane acquiring the codified text of art. 994 at the LawPrint URL above with the heading check and a recorded SHA-256 (the target already exists with expectedSha256 null), and art. 988 for the conditional fee exemption.
An owner answer to PF27's two art. 995 questions, so the required proposed order can be composed under a grant that names it.
